x: Odde was third in the 440 and Jack Brown won the 880 yards in 2 mins. 1.3 secs., with Archie Bedford in fourth place. Len Bishop was third in the 1 mile, but Charlie Smart surprised the locals by winning the 2-mile race, in which he beat Broughton, of Blackheath, in the fast time of 9 mins. 29.6 secs.
As usual we were minus any high jumpers, but Les Christmas and our new member, Odde, very sportingly filled in, in order to score points for the third and fourth places.

Thompson, the international runner, and " Mac " clocked 4 min. 33.8 secs., which is good going for a lad of his age. Ches Walker won the 440 yards, with Odde in second place, and Jack Brown won the 880, with Archie Bedford fourth.
Odde was second in the quarter and Gerry Trower won the junior 880 in good style and Ches Walker was also first home in the senior half-mile.
Odde second and Tom Underwood third.
Odde could only finish fourth in the 440 and seems to lack strength over the finish but no doubt this will come with more training and experience of scratch racing.
